meta.title: La Table de Marguerite — Gastronomic Bistro, Old Quebec
meta.description: La Table de Marguerite: gastronomic bistro in Old Quebec City. French and Quebecois cuisine, local and seasonal products, since 1987.

hero.title: A cuisine that tells the story of the land.
hero.subtitle: In the heart of Old Quebec, La Table de Marguerite has celebrated the flavors of Quebec for nearly four decades. Every plate is a tribute to our local producers.

philosophy.title: Our philosophy
philosophy.subtitle: Cuisine as an art of living, the terroir as a source of inspiration.
philosophy.p1: At La Table de Marguerite, every dish is a conversation between the land and the table. We work exclusively with local producers, from market gardeners to cheesemakers, to offer an authentic cuisine that evolves with the seasons.
philosophy.p2: Our chef Marguerite Tremblay draws from the French gastronomic tradition while celebrating Quebec's ingredients. The result: a sincere, generous cuisine deeply rooted in our terroir.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before your visit.
faq.q1: Do I need to reserve in advance?
faq.a1: Yes, we strongly recommend reservations, especially on Friday and Saturday evenings. You can reserve by phone at (418) 555-0142 or through our online form. We accept reservations up to 48 hours in advance.
faq.q2: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faq.a2: Absolutely. Our menu always features at least two vegetarian dishes and we can adapt most of our dishes for gluten-free diets. Please let us know about your dietary restrictions when making your reservation and our chef will be happy to accommodate.
faq.a3: We prefer smart casual attire. No shorts or beach sandals in the dining room, but no need for a tie either. The key is to feel comfortable and enjoy the meal.
faq.q4: Do you accept groups and private events?
faq.a4: Yes, our private dining room can accommodate up to 20 guests for special events: birthdays, business dinners, celebrations. Contact us for a personalized menu and custom quote.
faq.q5: Where do your products come from?
faq.a5: We work exclusively with Quebec producers. Our vegetables come from market gardeners in Portneuf and Ile d'Orleans, our meats from farms in Charlevoix and Lac Brome, our cheeses from artisans across Quebec. The menu changes with the seasons and arrivals.
faq.q6: Does Sunday brunch require a reservation?
faq.a6: Strongly recommended. Our Sunday brunch (10am-2pm) is very popular and spots fill quickly. The brunch menu features reimagined classics: smoked salmon eggs Benedict, maple souffle crepes, gourmet tartines and more.

meta.title: Our Story — La Table de Marguerite
meta.description: Discover the story of La Table de Marguerite, a gastronomic bistro founded in 1987 by Marguerite Tremblay in Old Quebec City.

hero.title: Our Story
hero.subtitle: From the Old Port market to rue du Petit-Champlain — 37 years of passion for Quebec's terroir.

story.title: From farm to table, since day one
story.p1: In 1987, Marguerite Tremblay opened the doors of a small bistro at 42 rue du Petit-Champlain with a simple conviction: the finest cuisine is born from respect for the products and the people who grow them. Trained at the Institut de tourisme et d'hotellerie du Quebec and then perfected in Lyon, she dreamed of marrying the rigor of French gastronomy with the generosity of Quebec's terroir.
story.p2: From day one, Marguerite forged bonds with local producers — market gardeners from Ile d'Orleans, cheesemakers from Charlevoix, fishermen from the Gaspe. These partnerships, some spanning three decades, are the foundation of our cuisine. Every morning, our team visits the markets to select the finest products of the day.
story.p3: Today, La Table de Marguerite is a gathering place for lovers of fine cuisine. Our bistro has evolved while preserving what gives it its soul: sincere cooking, exceptional products, and a warm welcome that makes you want to return.
story.quote: Cooking is the art of transforming the generosity of the land into moments of shared happiness.

values.title: Our values
values.subtitle: Three pillars that guide every decision, every dish, every welcome.

terroir.title: Terroir
terroir.description: 100% of our products come from Quebec. We celebrate the richness of our terroir by cooking with the seasons, respecting natural cycles and honoring the work of our local producers.

savoirfaire.title: Craftsmanship
savoirfaire.description: Every technique, every recipe is the fruit of decades of experience. We combine the precision of French gastronomy with Quebec creativity to create dishes that leave a lasting impression.

convivialite.title: Conviviality
convivialite.description: La Table de Marguerite is more than a restaurant — it is a place of sharing. Whether for a romantic dinner, a family meal or a celebration among friends, we create moments of happiness around the table.
